description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Golden Analytics is an AI-native business intelligence platform built for data teams. The Full Stack Engineer will own critical user experiences end to end, building AI-powered analytics features and integrating the platform with collaboration, notification, purchasing, and other customer systems.
Full-stack engineer building AI-powered analytics products with data preparation, visualizations, natural-language interfaces, and automation workflows

Responsibilities:
• AI-native data analysis, visualizations and dashboards
• Smart data preparation and enrichment
• Natural language interfaces for analytics
• Real-time collaboration tools
• Analytics-to-automation workflows

Requirements:
• Strong full stack development experience - Vite, TypeScript, React, Postgres, Supabase (and more as we grow)
• Experience building with AI/ML technologies (LLMs, vector databases, coding agents, etc.)
• Track record of shipping customer-facing products
• Product thinking and design sensibility
• Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration

Skills:
